summary: Prospective authority for a new surface: existing governed facts authorize a bounded CREATE operation, decided by a closed predicate, inspected after creation, never an anchor for a file that does not exist (sensei#312)
plan:
Extend the derived-coverage law so that a planned file that does not exist at the pinned world can be COVERED only by prospective authority derived from already-established facts about the surface it will be created into, and REFUTED after creation if the actual file does not match what was authorized.

THE PREDICATE (closed; anything not expressible here is UNRESOLVED and the file stays uncovered):
PROSPECTIVE_CREATE_ADMISSIBLE(F) iff
  A. F's parent directory contains a planned or existing file S that a derived anchor covers at the pinned world (S is the covering surface);
  B. F's declared package equals the package clause of S as read from S's bytes at the pinned world (git show <world>:S), never from the working tree;
  C. F matches exactly one governed prospective role from a closed set, and the declaration names that role. The only role in this change is go-regression-test: path matches *_test.go, in the same directory as S;
  D. every dependency F declares is either in S's import set at the pinned world, or in the role's explicit novel allowance. go-regression-test allows exactly one novel import: "testing".
When admissible, the coverage anchor recorded for F carries S's anchor family and requirement, and its description says PROSPECTIVE and names S; it must never read as an observation of F.

DECLARATION: the plan declares each prospective surface explicitly. Add to architectureDecision the field `prospective_surfaces`: [{"path":..., "package":..., "role":..., "dependencies":[...]}]. A planned file absent at the pinned world with NO declaration is uncovered exactly as today. The architect's JSON contract in architecturePrompt gains this field with a one-line instruction, so a natural run can declare a regression test; the supplied-plan parser needs no change because the field is a known one.

POST-CREATION INSPECTION: after the candidate exists and before the independent review is asked, read every declared prospective surface from the candidate diff. If the file was not created, or its package clause differs from the declaration, or its path does not match the role, or its imports include anything outside S's imports plus the role allowance, the run terminates with a WorkflowFailed whose message begins "prospective surface refuted:" and names the mismatch. No reinterpretation, no retry with another implementor, no review of a candidate whose authorized shape was not the shape produced.

LAWS PRESERVED: absence is not safety (an undeclared new file is uncovered); observation is not authority (S's neighbourhood alone grants nothing; the predicate is over established facts about S plus the declaration); a candidate is not a canonical claim (the declaration is checked against S's bytes at the pinned world and the predicate is closed; the architect wanting the file is not one of its clauses); closed vocabularies are read by membership (roles and allowances are maps, never read by exclusion).

REQUIRED FALSIFIERS as unit tests, each proving the file stays UNCOVERED or the candidate is REFUTED: wrong package; wrong directory; wrong role or path not matching the role; a novel import not in the allowance; S not covered by any anchor; a declaration with no matching planned file; and the bare case where the plan lists the file with no declaration at all. One positive case proves a correct declaration for gosumcheck-shaped input yields a PROSPECTIVE anchor carrying S's requirement. One inspection case proves a created file whose imports exceed the allowance is refuted after creation.

OUT OF SCOPE: any second role; any change to Sensei itself; any change to the routing rule that every planned file must be covered; any reading of the working tree for S; any anchor whose description could be mistaken for an observation of F.
steps: Add ProspectiveSurface {Path, Package, Role, Dependencies} and architectureDecision.ProspectiveSurfaces (json prospective_surfaces) in internal/workflow/prospective.go and engine.go.
Define the closed role table in prospective.go: go-regression-test -> path glob *_test.go, novel allowance {"testing"}; read by membership.

Implement prospectiveAnchors(ctx, world, planned, declarations, existingAnchors) applying clauses A-D, reading S's package clause and imports from git show <world>:S; return a CoverageAnchor per admissible F with Requirement = S's requirement and Describe prefixed PROSPECTIVE.
Call it from Engine.derivedCoverage for planned files absent at world, after the existing anchors are computed; undeclared absent files remain uncovered.
Add the prospective_surfaces field and a one-line instruction to the architect JSON contract in architecturePrompt.

Add inspectProspectiveSurfaces(diff, declarations, world facts) and call it in runCandidate after the candidate diff is read and before resolveReview; a mismatch returns an error beginning "prospective surface refuted:" and the run fails.
Write internal/workflow/prospective_test.go with the required falsifiers, the positive case, and the post-creation refutation case.
Run go test ./internal/workflow/... and go vet; record nothing as done that the tests do not prove.
consequences: A responsible plan that needs a new regression test beside a covered file can earn coverage for that file without any anchor pretending the file was observed. Every other new file is exactly as uncovered as today. After this lands the confinement-v2 natural task can reach the candidate boundary, which is what the #89 Series B reproducer needs.

claims.statement: derivedCoverage marks a planned file covered only if a derived anchor Covers(world, f); a file absent at world is never covered
derivationClosesGap requires every planned file to be covered; one anchor over two planned files is not coverage
the confinement-v2 natural task planned gosumcheck/main.go plus a nonexistent gosumcheck/main_test.go three times and routed cold each time
a single closed role with a single novel allowance is sufficient to let the confinement-v2 natural task reach the candidate boundary
